mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_risk_case WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
SELECT FROM crm_risk_case WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.id AS riskCaseId,o.id AS orderId,o.order_no AS orderNo, c.id AS customerId,c.customer_no AS customerNo,COALESCE(c.display_name,c.nickname) AS customerName FROM crm_risk_case r LEFT JOIN crm_order o ON o.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND o.id=r.order_id INNER JOIN crm_customer c ON c.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND c.id=COALESCE(o.customer_id,r.customer_id) WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.id IN #{riskCaseId} ORDER BY r.id

SELECT o.id AS sourceId,o.id AS orderId,o.order_no AS orderNo, c.id AS customerId,c.customer_no AS customerNo,COALESCE(c.display_name,c.nickname) AS customerName FROM crm_order o INNER JOIN crm_customer c ON c.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND c.id=o.customer_id WHERE o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND o.id IN #{sourceId}

SELECT yi.id AS sourceId,o.id AS orderId,o.order_no AS orderNo, c.id AS customerId,c.customer_no AS customerNo,COALESCE(c.display_name,c.nickname) AS customerName FROM crm_youzan_sync_issue yi INNER JOIN crm_youzan_event ye ON ye.tenant_id=yi.tenant_id AND ye.id=yi.event_id LEFT JOIN crm_youzan_order_map yom ON yom.tenant_id=ye.tenant_id AND yom.shop_id=ye.shop_id AND yom.external_order_no=ye.external_order_no LEFT JOIN crm_youzan_customer_link ycl ON ycl.tenant_id=ye.tenant_id AND ycl.shop_id=ye.shop_id AND ye.external_customer_id IS NOT NULL AND ycl.external_customer_id=ye.external_customer_id LEFT JOIN crm_order o ON o.tenant_id=yi.tenant_id AND o.id=COALESCE(ye.order_id,yom.crm_order_id) INNER JOIN crm_customer c ON c.tenant_id=yi.tenant_id AND c.id=COALESCE(o.customer_id,ycl.customer_id) WHERE yi.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND yi.id IN #{sourceId}

SELECT rf.id AS sourceId,o.id AS orderId,o.order_no AS orderNo, c.id AS customerId,c.customer_no AS customerNo,COALESCE(c.display_name,c.nickname) AS customerName FROM crm_refund rf LEFT JOIN crm_order o ON o.tenant_id=rf.tenant_id AND o.id=rf.order_id INNER JOIN crm_customer c ON c.tenant_id=rf.tenant_id AND c.id=COALESCE(o.customer_id,rf.customer_id) WHERE rf.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND rf.id IN #{sourceId}

SELECT e.id AS sourceId,o.id AS orderId,o.order_no AS orderNo, c.id AS customerId,c.customer_no AS customerNo,COALESCE(c.display_name,c.nickname) AS customerName FROM crm_entitlement e LEFT JOIN crm_order_item oi ON oi.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND oi.id=e.order_item_id LEFT JOIN crm_order o ON o.tenant_id=oi.tenant_id AND o.id=oi.order_id INNER JOIN crm_customer c ON c.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND c.id=COALESCE(o.customer_id,e.customer_id) WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.id IN #{sourceId}

SELECT rd.id AS sourceId,NULL AS orderId,NULL AS orderNo, c.id AS customerId,c.customer_no AS customerNo,COALESCE(c.display_name,c.nickname) AS customerName FROM crm_redemption rd INNER JOIN crm_customer c ON c.tenant_id=rd.tenant_id AND c.id=rd.customer_id WHERE rd.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND rd.id IN #{sourceId}

SELECT o.id AS orderId,COALESCE(o.customer_id,ycl.customer_id) AS customerId FROM crm_youzan_sync_issue yi INNER JOIN crm_youzan_event ye ON ye.tenant_id=yi.tenant_id AND ye.id=yi.event_id LEFT JOIN crm_youzan_order_map yom ON yom.tenant_id=ye.tenant_id AND yom.shop_id=ye.shop_id AND yom.external_order_no=ye.external_order_no LEFT JOIN crm_order o ON o.tenant_id=yi.tenant_id AND o.id=COALESCE(ye.order_id,yom.crm_order_id) LEFT JOIN crm_youzan_customer_link ycl ON ycl.tenant_id=ye.tenant_id AND ycl.shop_id=ye.shop_id AND ye.external_customer_id IS NOT NULL AND ycl.external_customer_id=ye.external_customer_id WHERE yi.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND yi.id=#{sourceId} AND (o.id IS NOT NULL OR ycl.customer_id IS NOT NULL)

SELECT o.id AS orderId,COALESCE(o.customer_id,rf.customer_id) AS customerId FROM crm_refund rf LEFT JOIN crm_order o ON o.tenant_id=rf.tenant_id AND o.id=rf.order_id WHERE rf.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND rf.id=#{sourceId}

SELECT o.id AS orderId,COALESCE(o.customer_id,e.customer_id) AS customerId FROM crm_entitlement e LEFT JOIN crm_order_item oi ON oi.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND oi.id=e.order_item_id LEFT JOIN crm_order o ON o.tenant_id=oi.tenant_id AND o.id=oi.order_id WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.id=#{sourceId}
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_risk_case SET customer_id=COALESCE(customer_id,#{customerId,jdbcType=BIGINT}), order_id=COALESCE(order_id,#{orderId,jdbcType=BIGINT}), updated_at=updated_at WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND status <> 'CLOSED' AND (customer_id IS NULL OR order_id IS NULL)

UPDATE crm_risk_case SET customer_id=#{customerId},updated_at=updated_at WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND source_type='YOUZAN_SYNC_ISSUE' AND order_id IS NULL AND status <> 'CLOSED' AND source_ref IN #{ref}

UPDATE crm_risk_case SET order_id=#{orderId},customer_id=#{customerId},updated_at=updated_at WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND source_type='YOUZAN_SYNC_ISSUE' AND status <> 'CLOSED' AND source_ref IN #{ref}

UPDATE crm_risk_case SET status=#{toStatus},owner_user_id=#{ownerUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, resolution=#{resolution,jdbcType=VARCHAR},resolved_at=#{resolvedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status=#{fromStatus}
